segments.an8.73:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā nātike [nādike (sī. syā.), nāṭike (pī.) a. ni.6.19] viharati giñjakāvasathe.
segments.an8.73:1.6: “maraṇassati, bhikkhave, bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā amatogadhā amatapariyosānā.
segments.an8.73:2.1: Evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.an8.73:2.3: “Yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ, bhikkhu, bhāvesi maraṇassatin”ti?
segments.an8.73:2.5: ‘aho vatāhaṃ rattindivaṃ jīveyyaṃ, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasi kareyyaṃ, bahu [bahuṃ (sī. pī.)] vata me kataṃ assā’ti.
segments.an8.73:2.6: Evaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, bhāvemi maraṇassatin”ti.
segments.an8.73:3.3: “Yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ, bhikkhu, bhāvesi maraṇassatin”ti?
segments.an8.73:3.5: ‘aho vatāhaṃ divasaṃ jīveyyaṃ, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasi kareyyaṃ, bahu vata me kataṃ assā’ti.
segments.an8.73:3.6: Evaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, bhāvemi maraṇassatin”ti.
segments.an8.73:4.3: “Yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ, bhikkhu, bhāvesi maraṇassatin”ti?
segments.an8.73:4.5: ‘aho vatāhaṃ upaḍḍhadivasaṃ jīveyyaṃ, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasi kareyyaṃ, bahu vata me kataṃ assā’ti.
segments.an8.73:4.6: Evaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, bhāvemi maraṇassatin”ti.
segments.an8.73:5.3: “Yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ, bhikkhu, bhāvesi maraṇassatin”ti?
segments.an8.73:5.5: ‘aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ ekapiṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasi kareyyaṃ, bahu vata me kataṃ assā’ti.
segments.an8.73:5.6: Evaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, bhāvemi maraṇassatin”ti.
segments.an8.73:6.3: “Yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ, bhikkhu, bhāvesi maraṇassatin”ti?
segments.an8.73:6.5: ‘aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ upaḍḍhapiṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasi kareyyaṃ, bahu vata me kataṃ assā’ti.
segments.an8.73:6.6: Evaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, bhāvemi maraṇassatin”ti.
segments.an8.73:7.3: “Yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ, bhikkhu, bhāvesi maraṇassatin”ti?
segments.an8.73:7.5: ‘aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ cattāro pañca ālope saṅkhāditvā [saṅkharitvā (ka.)] ajjhoharāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasi kareyyaṃ, bahu vata me kataṃ assā’ti.
segments.an8.73:7.6: Evaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, bhāvemi maraṇassatin”ti.
segments.an8.73:8.3: “Yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ, bhikkhu, bhāvesi maraṇassatin”ti?
segments.an8.73:8.5: ‘aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ ekaṃ ālopaṃ saṅkhāditvā [saṅkharitvā (ka.)] ajjhoharāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasi kareyyaṃ, bahu vata me kataṃ assā’ti.
segments.an8.73:8.6: Evaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, bhāvemi maraṇassatin”ti.
segments.an8.73:9.3: “Yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ, bhikkhu, bhāvesi maraṇassatin”ti?
segments.an8.73:9.5: ‘aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ assasitvā vā passasāmi, passasitvā vā assasāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasi kareyyaṃ, bahu vata me kataṃ assā’ti.
segments.an8.73:9.6: Evaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante bhāvemi maraṇassatin”ti.
segments.an8.73:10.1: Evaṃ vutte bhagavā te bhikkhū etadavoca –
segments.an8.73:10.2: “yvāyaṃ [yo cāyaṃ (ka. sī.)], bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇassatiṃ bhāveti –
segments.an8.73:10.3: ‘aho vatāhaṃ rattindivaṃ jīveyyaṃ, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasi kareyyaṃ, bahu vata me kataṃ assā’ti.
segments.an8.73:10.4: Yo cāyaṃ [yo pāyaṃ (ka.) a. ni.6.19 passitabbaṃ], bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇassatiṃ bhāveti –
segments.an8.73:10.5: ‘aho vatāhaṃ divasaṃ jīveyyaṃ, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasi kareyyaṃ, bahu vata me kataṃ assā’ti;
segments.an8.73:10.6: yo cāyaṃ [yo pāyaṃ (ka.) a. ni.6.19 passitabbaṃ], bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇassatiṃ bhāveti –
segments.an8.73:10.7: ‘aho vatāhaṃ upaḍḍhadivasaṃ jīveyyaṃ, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasi kareyyaṃ, bahu vata me kataṃ assā’ti.
segments.an8.73:10.8: Yo cāyaṃ [yo pāyaṃ (ka.) a. ni.6.19 passitabbaṃ], bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇassatiṃ bhāveti –
segments.an8.73:10.9: ‘aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ ekapiṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasi kareyyaṃ, bahu vata me kataṃ assā’ti;
segments.an8.73:10.10: yo cāyaṃ [yo pāyaṃ (ka.) a. ni.6.19 passitabbaṃ], bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇassatiṃ bhāveti –
segments.an8.73:10.11: ‘aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ upaḍḍhapiṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasi kareyyaṃ, bahu vata me kataṃ assā’ti.
segments.an8.73:10.12: Yo cāyaṃ [yo pāyaṃ (ka.) a. ni.6.19 passitabbaṃ], bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇassatiṃ bhāveti –
segments.an8.73:10.13: ‘aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ cattāro pañca ālope saṅkhāditvā ajjhoharāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasi kareyyaṃ, bahu vata me kataṃ assā’ti –
segments.an8.73:10.14: ime vuccanti, bhikkhave,‘bhikkhū pamattā viharanti, dandhaṃ maraṇassatiṃ bhāventi āsavānaṃ khayāya’”.
segments.an8.73:11.1: “Yo ca khvāyaṃ [yo cāyaṃ (syā.), yo ca kho yaṃ (ka.)], bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇassatiṃ bhāveti –
segments.an8.73:11.2: ‘aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ ekaṃ ālopaṃ saṅkhāditvā ajjhoharāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasi kareyyaṃ, bahu vata me kataṃ assā’ti.
segments.an8.73:11.3: Yo cāyaṃ [yo pāyaṃ (ka.)], bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇassatiṃ bhāveti –
segments.an8.73:11.4: ‘aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ assasitvā vā passasāmi, passasitvā vā assasāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasi kareyyaṃ, bahu vata me kataṃ assā’ti –
segments.an8.73:11.5: ime vuccanti, bhikkhave,‘bhikkhū appamattā viharanti, tikkhaṃ maraṇassatiṃ bhāventi āsavānaṃ khayāya’”.
segments.an8.73:12.2: ‘appamattā viharissāma, tikkhaṃ maraṇassatiṃ bhāvayissāma āsavānaṃ khayāyā’ti.

lines: So mamassa antarāyoti so mama jīvitantarāyopi, puthujjanakālakiriyaṃ karontassa saggantarāyopi maggantarāyopi assa.
Satthakā vā me vātāti satthaṃ viya aṅgamaṅgāni kantantīti satthakā.
Dasame kucchitaṃ sīdatīti kusīto da-kārassa ta-kāraṃ katvā.
Yassa dhammassa vasena puggalo “kusīto”ti vuccati, so kusitabhāvo idha kusita-saddena vutto.
Vināpi hi bhāvajotanasaddaṃ bhāvattho viññāyati yathā “paṭassa sukkan”ti, tasmā kusītabhāvavatthūnīti attho.
Taṃ pana caṅkamanavasena karaṇe kāyikantipi vattabbataṃ labhatīti āha “duvidhampī”ti.
Māsehi ācitaṃ nicitaṃ viyāti māsācitaṃ, taṃ maññe.
Yasmā māsā tintā visesena garukā honti, tasmā “yathā tintamāso”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Imināva nayenāti iminā kusītavatthūsu vutteneva nayena “duvidhampi vīriyaṃ ārabhatī”tiādinā.
Idaṃ paṭhamanti “idaṃ, handāhaṃ, vīriyaṃ ārabhāmī”ti,“evaṃ bhāvanāya abbhussahanaṃ paṭhamaṃ ārambhavatthū”tiādinā ca attho veditabbo.
Yathā tathā paṭhamaṃ pavattaṃ abbhussahanañhi upari vīriyārambhassa kāraṇaṃ hoti.
Anurūpapaccavekkhaṇasahitāni hi abbhussahanāni tammūlakāni vā paccavekkhaṇāni aṭṭha ārambhavatthūnīti veditabbāni.
